basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old software developer from Austin, Texas. I recently got into League of Legends and have been experimenting with different champions—currently obsessed with Akali. Outside of gaming, I'm passionate about vegan cooking and indie films. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work. I'm single and share an apartment with my cat, Mochi.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a computer science degree and work as a frontend developer. I picked up League of Legends during college and have been learning through online guides and watching streamers. My interests in veganism and film are mostly self-taught through YouTube and community discussions.
